title: Inside KSC! Jan. 10, 2020
description: Description Goes HereNASA and the European Space Agency are preparing to launch Solar Orbiter, a mission that will study the Sun, its outer atmosphere and solar wind. Liftoff of the United Launch Alliance Atlas V rocket is scheduled for Feb. 5 from Space Launch Complex 41 at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida. Also, SpaceX is gearing up for their In-Flight Abort Test, scheduled for Jan. 18, to demonstrate Crew Dragon's ability to safely separate from a Falcon 9 rocket.
